summary: Every place above g₀ or g₁ is a chosen place or the conjugate of one; there are f chosen places above each g_i.

steps.claim: The map from two copies of the chosen places (Σ_i chosen places above g_i), sending a place to itself on the first copy and to its conjugate on the second, maps onto every place above g₀ or g₁ (such a place or its conjugate is chosen, isChosen_star_iff), hence onto T; so |T| is at most the number of elements of the two copies.
steps.lean:
#T ≤ 4 * D.f := (univ.card_le_card_of_surjOn (D.chosen ⊕ᵥ star ∘ D.chosen) (s.trans fun _ ⟨_,
  a⟩ ↦ by simp [Set.range_comp, range_chosen, D.isChosen_star_iff a, em])).trans

steps.claim: That number is 2·(f + f) = 4f: there are f chosen places above each g_i (card_chosenPlace).
